editor.premise: A coastal holiday unfolds through travel, meals, browsing, swimming, and conversational updates, with a scrapbook-like preview of the days ahead.

chapters.name: Getting there
chapters.purpose: Compress the journey into a framed travel montage.

chapters.name: Room tour
chapters.purpose: Establish the holiday base, saving the balcony view for last.

chapters.name: Terrace lunch
chapters.purpose: Move from coastal setting to food, tasting, and souvenir snapshots.

chapters.name: Walking update
chapters.purpose: Connect destinations while giving the morning a conversational recap.

chapters.name: Shop browsing
chapters.purpose: Replace face-led coverage with objects, handling, and purchasing deliberation.

chapters.name: Dessert stop
chapters.purpose: Build a small selection-to-tasting sequence, then punctuate the outing.

chapters.name: Afternoon swim
chapters.purpose: Release the walking-and-shopping rhythm into playful water-level coverage.

chapters.name: Beach reading
chapters.purpose: Slow down for a seated book discussion before changing scenes.

chapters.name: Evening dinner
chapters.purpose: Introduce the evening setting and company, then move into eating.

captions.note: Small bottom-centered subtitles dominate; centered activity labels and opening titles add hierarchy. Occasional ratings and diary asides punctuate bites and browsing.

editor.notes: Alternate short music-led montages with longer conversational runs. Cut repeated actions down to bites and gestures. Use scrapbook stills and black pauses as punctuation; hold the view reveal longer than the room details.
